channel.title: ToolDune
channel.description: Free online tools: countdown timers, calculators, unit converters, text tools and generators.

item.title: Standby Power Calculator — What Idle Electronics Cost You
item.description: The always-on leak: standby watts times hours times price gives the yearly cost of idle electronics - with the warm-when-off hunt and the switchable-lead fix. Free.

item.title: Shower vs Bath Calculator — Real Cost per Wash
item.description: Shower or bath - which costs less? Minutes, flow and energy price give the weekly cost of each, the litres saved, and the exact crossover time. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Dripping Tap Calculator — Litres and Money Down the Drain
item.description: What does a dripping tap waste? Drips per minute times the clock gives litres per year and cost, hot-tap doubling and the meter leak test. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Pet Treat Calculator — The 10% Rule in Pieces per Day
item.description: How many treats can your pet have? The veterinary 10% rule turns daily food calories into a treat budget, in pieces, with the human-food dangers listed. Free.

item.title: Cat Food Portion Calculator — Grams per Day by Weight and Stage
item.description: How much should your cat eat? Weight and stage give kcal by the feline RER formula, then grams from the bag - plus the 4-meal rhythm and scale discipline. Free.

item.title: Dog Food Portion Calculator — Grams per Day by Weight and Stage
item.description: How much should your dog eat? Weight and life stage give kcal via the vet formula, then grams from the bag's energy - with the measuring-cup trap exposed. Free.

item.title: BBQ Charcoal Calculator — Briquettes by Guests and Hours
item.description: How much charcoal for the barbecue? Guests times grill hours plus fire-up, in briquettes, chimney starters and kilos - with the two-zone layout. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Gift Budget Calculator — Holiday Spending Without the January Bill
item.description: Total your holiday gift spending by tier - partner, kids, family, friends, colleagues - then fund it across three months instead of one credit-card statement. Free.

item.title: Rent Split Calculator — Fair Share by Room Size
item.description: Split rent fairly by room size: private rooms pay their own square metres, shared space splits equally - with the en-suite and couple adjustments explained. Free.

item.title: 401k Match Calculator — Free Money From Your Employer
item.description: What is your employer match worth? Salary, contribution and match formula give the free annual amount, what you leave on the table, and its 20-year value. Free.

item.title: Party Budget Calculator — Real Cost per Guest, Food to Extras
item.description: What will the party cost? Guests times per-head food and drink plus decorations, with the per-guest figure and the 1.5 invite rule built in. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Halloween Candy Calculator — How Many Bags to Buy
item.description: How much Halloween candy for your street? Trick-or-treater count, pieces per kid and bag size give bags, cost and the half-show floor. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Flashcard Revision Calculator — New Cards per Day Until the Exam
item.description: How many flashcards per day? Deck size and days to exam give the new-card rate, total reviews, peak minutes and the last day to add cards. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Exam Study Planner — Week-by-Week Plan from Your Exam Date
item.description: Enter your exam date and subjects for the week-by-week plan: syllabus audit, past papers, error log drills - with hours per day and the last-new-topic date. Free.

item.title: Hiking Time Calculator — Naismith's Rule with Breaks
item.description: How long does that hike take? Distance, ascent and pace give walking time by Naismith's rule, plus break allowance and the turnaround point. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Backpack Weight Calculator — Total Load and the 20% Rule
item.description: Weigh your backpack before your shoulders do: base gear, food and water by trip days, total load and the 20% of body weight verdict. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Tent Size Calculator — What Rated Capacity to Actually Buy
item.description: What size tent for your group? Sleepers plus the +1 rule, with floor dimensions, packed weight and shoulder room - backpacking vs family. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Coast FIRE Calculator — Invested Today, Retired by Compounding
item.description: How much invested today means retirement at your target age with zero further saving? Coast FIRE number, surplus or deficit, and the return sensitivity. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: Savings Rate Calculator — Years of Work Left at Your Rate
item.description: Your savings rate decides when work becomes optional: rate from income and spending, then years to FI on the famous 5%-return table. Free, no sign-up.

item.title: FIRE Number Calculator — Your Financial Independence Target
item.description: Your FIRE number: annual spending divided by an honest withdrawal rate (3.25-4.5%), with the gap, coast years and passive income shown. Free, no sign-up.
